g.text: Public repositories: workers ask before every push, at every level.
Never run git on this computer in the mounted folder: not by hand, not in a git-aware prompt, not in an editor.
Without VOICE_GW_DOCKER, workers run in your checkouts as before.
Orange: cloud service · purple: own code · blue: Claude Code · red: written by the container · green: clean · dashed: optional
